name: N.O.N.E.Z.
source: Years of traveling and wondering about what could have been if you did something different can be tiresome for a human. The main character of the third and last installment of the N.E.M.O. trilogy knows well how it feels. For decades, Zenon has been trying to reclaim his past life and finally get his happy ending. During the story, you can accompany him while he uses the N.E.M.O. machine to try and discover the source of his misfortune. Will he succeed in finding his final destination or will it fail like everything in his past? See for yourself in N.O.N.E.Z.!
